name: keyless-reel-harness
description: Keyless, offline-first Arabic/English reel factory (HyperFrames + FFmpeg + WhisperX/Auto-Editor + Agent Skills)

scripts.harness:stages: python3 scripts/build-harness-promo.py --words-source-only && mkdir -p out && touch out/harness-promo-45s.mp4 && npm run reel -- --lang en --project videos/harness-promo-45s --input videos/harness-promo-45s/assets/narration.wav --offline --from-json videos/harness-promo-45s/config/words.source.json --skip-compose --skip-render --skip-qa --fps 30 --out out/harness-promo-45s.mp4 --goal saves && node scripts/compose.mjs --lang en --project videos/harness-promo-45s --headline "One idea. One finished reel." --subtitle "Word-timed captions and frame-locked motion" && npm run harness:build
scripts.harness:render: npm run render -- --project videos/harness-promo-45s --out out/harness-promo-45s.mp4 --lang en --backend hyperframes --fps 30
scripts.harness:qa: npm run qa -- --project videos/harness-promo-45s --out out/harness-promo-45s.mp4 --lang en --fps 30
scripts.harness:all: npm run harness:stages && npm run harness:check && npm run harness:render && npm run harness:qa
